## Documentation 

Zeroheight link: _add link here_

_________
Documentation creation process:
1. Component is designed
2. Zeroheight task is created to Design board
8. Documentation review (by second designer)
9. Accessibility page is added (by WCAG specialist)
10. Documentation is published 
11. Zeroheight link is added to Release notes page in Zeroheight
12. Zeroheight page link is added to Figma
13. Zeroheight page link is added to Storybook (done by developers)
_________

## 1. Documentation
- [ ] **Introduction page** is created - _includes instructions and examples_
  - [ ] **Links are added** - _cross reference to Figma and both Storybooks_
  - [ ] Examples are added through Figma file: https://www.figma.com/design/i051VHzYhGnlTG2glEOdJS/Zeroheight?node-id=0-1&t=lNBvip1vRvFjorFO-1
  - [ ] Follow the structure of previous pages
- [ ] **Writing principles** is created _(optional)_ - _added only if the component includes text_

Send the documentation to reviewer and accessibility specialist. You can send it to several reviewers at once.

## 2. Design review
_Action is done in the same issue, on the [Design board](https://github.com/orgs/TEDI-Design-System/projects/2/views/7)._
1. When the documentation is ready, add the ZH link to the GitHub issue 
2. Move it to the **Review column** in GitHub
3. Assign it to a design team member

_Design review: designer checks if every use case is described_

## 3. Accessibility page is being filled
_Action is done in the same issue, on the [Design board](https://github.com/orgs/TEDI-Design-System/projects/2/views/7)._
1. When the documentation is ready, add the ZH link to the GitHub issue 
2. Move it to the **Review column** in GitHub
3. Assign it to a accesibility specialist
- [ ] **Accessibility page** is created - _includes instructions to meet accessibility requirements_

## 5. For publisher
- [ ] Publish ZH page
- [ ] Update [statuses page in Zeroheight](https://tedi.tehik.ee/1ee8444b7/p/300e17-komponentide-staatused)
- [ ] Add Zeroheight link to Figma Documentation section
- [ ] Add Zeroheight link to Figma asset description
- [ ] Change Documentation status in Figma header
- [ ] Add info to Zeroheight [release notes](https://tedi.zeroheight.com/styleguide/s/118912/p/0316fd-release-notes 
) if new page is created
- [ ] **Close the issue** in GitHub if all the reviews are done 
  - [ ] Add tasks to the [Development board](https://github.com/orgs/TEDI-Design-System/projects/7/views/1?filterQuery=) (React and Angular separately) so the dev team will know to add link to Storybook 
- [ ] Check if the component is related to any of the [Discussions](https://github.com/orgs/TEDI-Design-System/discussions), if yes then close the discussion with a comment that includes infot about the component being designed.
